# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by desktop environment and application icons)
- **Application**: LibreOffice Impress
- **Window Title**: ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress
- **Date and Time**: Oct 22 23:18
- **System Tray Icons**: Present in top-right corner (including sound, network, and power icons)
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner

## Desktop Environment and Application Icons

- **Left Dock/Panel**:
  - Activities button at top
  - Application icons from top to bottom:
    - Google Chrome
    - Thunderbird email client
    - Visual Studio Code
    - VLC media player
    - LibreOffice Writer
    - LibreOffice Calc
    - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
    - GIMP image editor
    - File manager
    - Software center (AppGrid)
    - Help icon (?)
    - Trash icon
  - Grid icon at bottom for application launcher

## LibreOffice Impress Menu Bar

- **Menu Options** (from left to right):
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Slide
  - Slide Show
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbars

### Main Toolbar (Above Menu Bar)

- **Icons** (from left to right):
  - New document
  - Open document
  - Save document
  - Save as
  - Print
  - Cut
  - Copy
  - Paste
  - Undo
  - Redo
  - Find
  - Spelling and grammar check
  - Grid view
  - Slide layout
  - Drawing tools
  - Text box
  - Shapes (rectangle, oval, arrow, line, etc.)
  - Icons for inserting images, charts, tables, and other objects
  - Text formatting tools (font, size, color, alignment)
  - Slide show controls
  - Zoom and view controls

### LibreOffice Donation Banner

- **Location**: Top of the main workspace, below the menu bar
- **Content**:
  - Blue banner with two informational icons (i)
  - Text: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button
  - Text: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button
  - Close button (X) on the right side of each message

## Slide Navigation Panel

- **Location**: Left side of the screen
- **Content**:
  - Slide thumbnails for slides 2 through 10
  - Slide 10 is currently selected (highlighted with a brown border)
  - Each thumbnail shows a preview of the slide content
  - Slide 10 is titled "2. PROGRAMS/SERVICES/MENTORING"
  - Slide 1 is not visible in the thumbnail panel
  - Slide 18 is indicated as the total number of slides at the bottom

## Main Slide Workspace

- **Current Slide**: Slide 10 of 18
- **Slide Title**: "2. PROGRAMS/SERVICES/MENTORING"
- **Slide Content**:
  - **Goal 2.1**: Realign existing conferences, meetings, webinars, workshops, and other programs and services to meet more closely the needs of both academics and professionals.
  - **Goal 2.2**: Provide a more effective conduit between academics and professionals.
  - **Goal 2.3**: Expand and strengthen programs and services at the local/regional, SIG, and international levels.
  - **Goal 2.4**: Introduce a variety of mentoring programs for academic and professional leadership.
- **Footer**:
  - Logo: "asis&t" in red cursive font
  - Text: "Association for Information Science and Technology"

## Properties Panel

- **Location**: Right side of the screen
- **Panel Title**: Properties
- **Section**: Slide
- **Properties**:
  - Format: Widescreen (dropdown)
  - Orientation: Landscape (dropdown)
  - Background: None (dropdown) with "Insert Image..." button
  - Master Slide: Title and Content (dropdown)
  - Master Background: Checked
  - Master Objects: Checked
  - Master View: Button
- **Layouts Section**:
  - Collapsed by default
  - Contains multiple layout thumbnails (grid of 3x3)
  - Each thumbnail shows a different slide layout with title and content areas

## Status Bar

- **Location**: Bottom of the screen
- **Content**:
  - "Slide 10 of 18"
  - "Title and Content" (current slide layout)
  - Coordinates: "-0.52 /
